purpose: Specify the algorithm that converts wearable sensor readings back to estimated ICP.

specification.model_form: Bayesian inverse model. P(ICP_t | C_t, C_{t-1}, C_{t-2}, ...) where C = measured concentration
must_account_for: Transport delay (step 4) — convolution with transport kernel
Patient-specific parameters — calibrated at baseline (initial implant)
specification.calibration_procedure: On implantation, perform controlled ICP challenge (e.g., head-up tilt test). Measure sensor response. Fit patient-specific transport delay and clearance rate.
specification.accuracy_target_mmhg: +/- 3 (so that clinically meaningful ICP changes of >5 mmHg are detectable)
specification.update_rate_hz: 0.1 (one ICP estimate every 10 seconds — sufficient for clinical decisions)

what_unfreezes_this: Steps 1-6 fully resolved (molecule, release kinetics, transport, clearance, sensor).
implementation_required: Bayesian inverse solver (e.g., particle filter, extended Kalman filter, or variational inference)
Validation against gold-standard invasive ICP measurement (intraventricular catheter)
status_provenance: MODEL_DERIVED from signal processing + Bayesian inference
